topic: Setting up my new work laptop
passage: Last Monday, my manager handed me a new laptop and asked me to set it up before lunch. I carried it back to my desk, opened the box, and plugged it in. The screen lit up after a few seconds, and I signed in with my work account. First, I looked up the setup guide on the company website and wrote down the steps on a sticky note. Then I downloaded the office tools and installed them one by one. The first try failed, so I restarted the laptop and tried again. This time it worked, and I felt a little relieved. After that, I copied my old files from a small hard drive and backed them up to the team folder. A colleague walked over and pointed out that I had missed the security software. I thanked him, searched for the package, and added it right away. At noon, I tested the camera and joined a short meeting to check the sound. I packed up the old laptop and dropped it off at the tech support desk. When I sat down again, I smiled, because the new machine made my work feel lighter.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录，主弱项继续是过去式 -ed 听辨和短语动词连读，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「给新工作电脑装系统」是全新的工作科技话题，短文里有 handed/asked/carried/opened/plugged/signed/looked/downloaded/installed/failed/restarted/tried/worked/copied/backed/walked/pointed/missed/thanked/searched/added/tested/joined/packed/dropped/smiled 等规则过去式；set up、plugged in、lit up、signed in、looked up、wrote down、backed up、walked over、pointed out、packed up、dropped off、sat down 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
